s.t:
Become a part of our caring community Humana’s Insurance Product Experience team was established to think holistically about the member experience, embedding with business stakeholders and looking across channels to identify and define opportunities to better support our members across the healthcare and health insurance experience.

Our team serves a unique role for the enterprise in bringing together stakeholders and partners to define future experiences and to deliver against our experience vision. Asa Service Designer , you will support concept initiatives across framing, research, experience design, testing, and planning for implementation.

We are looking for a highly curious and hardworking designer who is ready to dive in to a multitude of member challenges and opportunities – from helping people find a provider that meets their needs to reimagining the moment members apply for a new plan.

If you are motivated by making real change in an industry where it’s much needed, we would love to talk. Responsibilities Service strategy + visioning: Support visioning and concept development projects, assisting with user research, analysis and synthesis, concept ideation, prototyping and testing, and implementation planning.

Information design, prototyping + storytelling: Contribute to the design and delivery of components integral to communicating our work, e.g., service blueprints, low- and mid-fidelity prototypes, frameworks, concept illustrations, slides.

Cross-functional partnership + collaboration: Collaborate with UX/UI designers, product teams, marketing, and operations to ensure seamless integration between digital tools and offline touchpoints.

Emotional intelligence + curiosity: Demonstrate ability to listen and to thoughtfully contribute to business stakeholder and channel partner team conversations, strengthening our ability to deliver through cross-enterprise collaboration.

Industry understanding: Stay informed about industry trends in health insurance, digital health, and service design best practices. An exceptional Service Designer will… Craft visual stories that make complex concepts simple to understand, highlighting what is new and important to help us make decisions.

Quickly prototype products and services to test conceptual requirements, demonstrating to stakeholders and users how we might address a problem or need. Never lose sight of the member and business problem and always articulate the why. Deliver thoughtful work efficiently.

Use your skills to make an impact Required Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Design, HCD, or a related field 1-3 years of relevant industry experience Portfolio demonstrating foundational skills in journey mapping, user research, prototyping, information design and/or illustration.

s.h: About the team and the role
s.t:
Platform Engineering enables business growth by providing the shared foundation that lets Adyen engineers autonomously build and support secure, scalable, and reliable products — from data centers and networks to deployment environments and database solutions.
As Senior Service Designer for Platform Engineering, you will improve the end-to-end developer experience across internal tools, workflows, and platform capabilities. The role blends service design, UX strategy, and hands-on design consultancy. You will act as the bridge between high-level strategy and tactical execution, making Platform Engineering feel and function like a single, cohesive experience rather than ~100 disconnected products.
You will start with the Developer Center — the central developer platform and launch pad for everything else — then expand to the journey across the wider developer ecosystem, which today is fragmented and inconsistent. You will work on both improving what exists and shaping what comes next.
You can expect an 80/20 split as you come into Adyen, where 80% of your time and work will be in service design, and 20% could involve hands-on user experience or user interface design. At Adyen, people own their career, so while this is what you can expect initially, this role will be yours to shape.
Why this role
Greenfield by design. Service design as a coordinated practice does not yet exist at Adyen. You are not inheriting a playbook — you are writing it, and socializing it across PX as the example of what good looks like.
Real scope, real impact. Your users are ~1,500 engineers. The frictions you remove and the journeys you connect translate directly into how fast Adyen can build and ship.
A seat where decisions are made. You will influence and co-create roadmaps and priorities with engineering and product leadership — not just respond to them.
Room to grow the craft. You will teach and share service design across the PX practice, helping other designers adopt these methods and creating a multiplier effect well beyond your own projects.

Build the service ecosystem. Map and own the end-to-end service journey for Platform Engineering. You look beyond the screen to design how people, processes, and technology work together to create a seamless experience.
Drive continuous improvement across systems. Create interventions that change how whole teams and systems work together, advancing the organization — not just individual features.
Enable design thinking at scale. Act as a consultant to product and engineering teams, giving them the tools and methodologies to apply design to their own problem spaces.
Shape AI-enabled developer experiences. Design how AI shows up in developer workflows — from discovery and self-service to troubleshooting, documentation, and automation — applying it where it creates real value and improves productivity without adding complexity.
Define the strategic vision. Take ownership of broad, undefined spaces within the internal developer platform. You frame the problem and create a clear service strategy that balances user needs with technical and regulatory constraints.
Consult on UX/UI excellence. Partner with product teams to ensure individual features align with the broader platform logic and meet our high bar for usability. Should be comfortable solving or unblocking UI or UX problems as they arise in teams.
Partner across the organization. Work with Product, Technology, and Data Analytics to turn complex data into actionable service blueprints and long-term roadmaps.
Articulate value. Communicate service methodologies and the tangible business impact they deliver to senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
This is you
Experience. 8+ years in design overall, including 3+ years specifically in service design, navigating complex software or hardware environments. You have a proven track record of using service design to simplify intricate workflows in SaaS or B2B products.
Full-stack service design. You develop a deep, top-to-bottom understanding of the systems underlying developer touchpoints, so you can make operational improvements that matter to people and have a positive impact on developer satisfaction and retention.
Systems thinking. You see the big picture. You map intricate journeys that span entire ecosystems — looking up, down, and across — ensuring consistency and logic at every touchpoint.
Consulting mindset. You are comfortable as a coach and advisor, empowering other teams to make design-led decisions while holding a high bar for the final output.
Exceptional communication. Standout facilitation and storytelling skills. You think about both company systems and people systems, and you build alignment across teams that don’t naturally work together.
Technically fluent. Strongly tech-savvy and comfortable in technical conversations without needing to be an engineer. Ideally you’ve built complex application offerings or worked as a systems designer in an ecosystem environment.
AI and innovation mindset. You have experience integrating AI tools into the end-to-end design process — leveraging AI for research, synthesis, or prototyping — and you can enable others to use these tools to work smarter and faster.

Familiarity with business banking, fintech, or enterprise financial services, and comfort with data-heavy surfaces and complex financial user needs.
International work experience.
Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments
Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.
Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!
What’s next?
Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

Joining frog means you’ll be joining the “pond,” a global network of studios, each with a thriving in-person and vibrant virtual culture. frogs are curious, collaborative, and courageous, united by our passion for improving the human experience through design, while each bringing our unique and diverse skills and experiences to the table.

Service Designers are responsible for the design of systems made of people, digital, and physical touchpoints. They orchestrate value exchanges among them in ways that make the system sustainable for both the users and providers.

As a Senior Service Designer, you are expected to represent depth in the craft of service design: as an individual contributor, as a mentor and guide for more junior colleagues, and as a contributor to the global community of practice. You will often be the backbone of your projects from beginning to end.

You will plan, prioritize, and deliver service design activities autonomously, in the context of interdisciplinary projects. You will lead client conversations within your domain, providing articulate recommendations and helping guide client choices.

You will have opportunities to lead small teams on projects and contribute to business development through proposal-writing and pitches.

s.h: In this role you will play a key role in
s.t:
Driving the design of systemic interventions in complex, multi-partner ecosystems
Championing visual frameworks – like journey maps, service blueprints, ecosystem maps – that help bring clarity to complex challenges in human behaviors, relationships, workflow and processes, and drive decision making
Driving contribution and alignment from multiple stakeholders, whether clients, third-party or larger ecosystem player
Utilizing experience prototyping techniques like desktop walkthrough and role playing that help test and validate service components and to convey value propositions
Advocating service providers as much as service users and communication objective in mind
Travel is required 50-75%, dependent on client needs.
You should have experience and a proven ability to think commercially, strategically, and creatively.

s.h: Our ideal candidate has the following characteristics
s.t:
5+ years of professional service design experience (although you might had a different job title, like “strategic designer” or “business designer”)
Highly developed design skills, demonstrated in your portfolio of recent work
Confident presentation and storytelling abilities
Experience collaborating in multifunctional teams as the service design lead
Proficiency with contemporary design and prototyping tools and methods

Preferred: A university degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, or a related design or artistic discipline

What You’ll Love About Working Here?

Build a network within the Capgemini Group and contribute to the education of other Business Units around practice offerings to support existing account expansion
Play a significant role in client proposals and RFI/RFP responses from initial brief to final sales presentations
Nurture and expand existing account relationships
Identify potential personal business relationships that can be leveraged by the practice to develop new business
Identify potential project extension and expansion opportunities while staffed on projects
Support the development of thought leadership and innovative offerings as they relate to AI/Data Science, Digital Customer Analytics, and Operational Analytics.
Support the upskilling of the team members on topics related to Data & Analytics

Service Designer:in mit Schwerpunkt UX Writing (w/m/d)
Für uns bedeutet gute User Experience mehr als intuitive digitale Oberflächen. Wir betrachten Produkte, Prozesse und Services ganzheitlich und aus Sicht unserer Kundinnen und Kunden – über digitale und nicht digitale Kontaktpunkte hinweg.
Als Teil unseres UX\-Teams arbeitest du gemeinsam mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen daran, Bankthemen kundenorientiert zu gestalten. Dabei verbindest du Service Design, User\-Centred Design und UX Writing: Du verstehst Bedürfnisse und Zusammenhänge, machst sie sichtbar und entwickelst daraus gemeinsam mit anderen, konkrete Lösungen.
Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt deiner Rolle liegt auf Sprache und Inhalten. Denn gute Kundenerlebnisse entstehen, wenn Kundinnen und Kunden verstehen, worum es geht.
Du möchtest nicht nur einzelne Screens oder Texte optimieren, sondern Produkte, Prozesse und Services insgesamt besser machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich.
Service Designer:in mit Schwerpunkt UX Writing (w/m/d)
Dein Job im Überblick
Was du bei uns bewirkst
Du gestaltest Customer Journeys und Services ganzheitlich über alle Kontaktpunkte hinweg und sorgst dafür, dass überzeugende Kundenerlebnisse entstehen.
Du setzt Methoden aus Service Design und User\-Centred Design gezielt und pragmatisch ein und bringst unterschiedliche Fachbereiche zu konkreten Lösungen zusammen.
Du führst mit Kundinnen und Kunden Interviews und Usertests durch und übersetzt die gewonnenen Erkenntnisse im interdisziplinären Team in konkrete Verbesserungen.
Du gehst komplexen Produkten sowie Prozessen auf den Grund und machst daraus kundenorientierte Inhalte.
Du strukturierst Informationen so, dass Kundinnen und Kunden finden, was für sie relevant ist und sicher handeln können. Dabei vertrittst du die Kundenperspektive und begründest sprachliche sowie konzeptionelle Entscheide gegenüber den Fachbereichen.
Du entwickelst unsere UX\-Writing\-Standards, Tonalität und Terminologie weiter und schaffst mit Prinzipien, Vorlagen und Best Practices eine konsistente Kommunikation.
Du trägst dazu bei, gute UX über einzelne Projekte hinaus nachhaltig in unseren Produkten, Prozessen und Services zu verankern.
Das bringst du mit
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Service Design, UX Design, Interaction Design, User Research, UX Writing oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.
Bachelorabschluss oder eine höhere Ausbildung in Service Design, Kommunikation, Psychologie, Human\-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.
Ausgeprägte Textkompetenz in Deutsch und ein sehr gutes Gespür für klare, verständliche und natürlich wirkende Sprache.
Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Produkte, Prozesse und fachliche Zusammenhänge zu erfassen und konsequent aus Kundensicht verständlich aufzubereiten.
Erfahrung in der Planung und Moderation von Workshops sowie in der selbstständigen Durchführung und Auswertung von Kundeninterviews und Usertests.
Eine analytische Denkweise, ein gutes Gespür für Menschen, Interessen und Gruppendynamiken sowie die Fähigkeit, Erkenntnisse aus Research, Daten und Feedback in konkrete Verbesserungen zu übersetzen.
Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit, Sicherheit im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern sowie Neugier und Bereitschaft, dich vertieft in neue Themen und Fachbereiche einzuarbeiten.
Von Vorteil sind Kompetenzen in Informationsarchitektur, visueller Gestaltung und Prototyping, sehr gute Kenntnisse in Figma sowie Erfahrung im Bankenwesen oder einem anderen komplexen bzw. stark regulierten Umfeld. Auch Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI für UX Research und Prototyping ist willkommen.

Mehr Zeit für dich
Bei uns sind kantonale und regionale Feiertage bezahlt. Zusätzlich erwarten dich Sabbaticals und extra Ferientage zum Dienstjubiläum.

Profitiere von einem grosszügigen Mutter\- oder Vaterschaftsurlaub sowie von zusätzlichen Familienzulagen.
Starke Vorsorge
Mit unserer firmeneigenen Pensionskasse bist du auf der sicheren Seite.
Individuelle Weiterentwicklung
Wir fördern dich bei deiner internen und externen Aus\- und Weiterbildung, sodass du am Ball bleibst.
Exklusive Vorteile
Personalkonditionen auf LUKB\-Produkte und viele externe Vergünstigungen schonen dein Portemonnaie.

Bixal is hiring a Senior Service Designer / UX Researcher to join our Developer Experience team on a newly awarded platform engineering contract with the Department of Education's Federal Student Aid (FSA). FSA manages nearly $1.7 trillion in federal student loans and serves more than 45 million borrowers. This contract is building the platform engineering foundation that enables FSA's engineering teams to deliver faster, more securely, and with less friction.
You will be the embedded HCD practitioner on a four-person Developer Experience team, working alongside a Technical Product Manager, a Content/Documentation Specialist, and a Software Engineer. Your job is to make the platform something developers actually want to use.

You'll map the end-to-end developer journey, identify friction, run sprint-cadence usability testing, and translate research directly into the backlog. The people you're designing for are software engineers and developers, not end users of a public-facing website, and that distinction matters.
Applicants must include a link to a portfolio of relevant work.

This is a fully remote position that can be worked anywhere in the U.S. While most of the work is expected to be conducted virtually, there is potential for occasional travel for on-site meetings and working sessions (Washington, D.C.) at the discretion of the client. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship. U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to contractual requirement.

The salary range for this role is $125,000 – $130,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Research and Discovery
Map the end-to-end developer journey from access request through first production deploy, identifying high-friction points at each stage.
Plan and execute sprint-cadence user research with FSA engineering teams using methods such as contextual inquiry, usability testing, interviews, and behavioral analytics.
Synthesize qualitative and quantitative findings into actionable insights and translate them directly into prioritized backlog items.
rack adoption metrics and developer satisfaction (Developer NPS) to measure the impact of improvements over time.
Service Design
Design service blueprints, interaction patterns, user flows, and high-fidelity prototypes for developer-facing products including the self-service portal, onboarding toolkit, and golden-path templates.
Deliver design specifications and documentation that reduce implementation ambiguity and improve fidelity between design intent and what gets built.
Collaborate with the team’s software engineer to keep the iteration loop tight within a single sprint cadence, ensuring research-backed interaction patterns are reflected in working software.
Design responsive, accessible interfaces that account for regulatory and secure interaction requirements without degrading usability.
Apply accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG 2.1) to all developer-facing interfaces and documentation experiences.
Contribute to a developer experience metrics dashboard, defining what gets measured and why.
Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement
Work closely with the team’s Technical Product Manager to align research priorities with the product roadmap and QASP performance measures.
Engage FSA engineering stakeholders to understand their workflows, constraints, and needs, building trust and buy-in for platform adoption.
Participate in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, demos, and retrospectives.
Coordinate with adjacent vendor teams and FSA stakeholders to ensure the developer experience serves the broader engineering ecosystem.
